notes.notes:

notes.title: Bug fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
- Fixed fries sometimes giving cook amount error when they were properly cooked
- Added notifications on the right side of the screen when a customer's mood changes and when they get angry and leave the restaurant
- Food now cooks slightly slower if it is already done to give more time before it gets burnt

notes.title: Multiplayer Hotfix
notes.notes: -Fixed player being unable to move in multiplayer

notes.title: Tutorial update
notes.notes:
The main change in this update is the new tutorial. The first time you hit play the game will recommend to play the tutorial, and it will be always available to play below the save file selection.

Adjustments and bug fixes
- Food now makes a clear transition from being uncooked to cooked (this includes patties, bacon and french fries)
- Fixed some delivered orders being treated as wrong when they weren't.
- Fixed subtracting the wrong amount of reputation points when buying a cosmetic in the lobby
- Added new hand icon when looking at interactable objects

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed customers despawning if only one of the same table leave the restaurant
- Fixed money sometimes going into the negatives after buying in the shop
- Fixed not being able to swap from smash burger tool to the pepper bottle
- Fixed additional burger builders not working if bought when selecting a starting day
- Fixed ready signs in the lobby doing the turn animation again when a player changes clothes
- Fixed cutting boards affecting each other if being used at the same time

notes.title: Current roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello players,
After listening to the feedback, I'm sharing the current plans for future updates to improve the game:
[list]
[h2][*]Dedicated tutorial level[/h2]
A lot of the problems players have come from a lack of understanding about how the mechanics work due to not having a proper tutorial to explain it. This has the highest priority as it is essential so that players can enjoy the game.
[h2][*]More menu items[/h2]
Burgers are great, but having only one main dish can get a bit repetitive, so more items will be added. For now the main ideas are adding hot dogs and wraps.
[h2][*]Quality of life[/h2]
Any small changes that can improve the experience will also be added, for example expanding the options menu with more settings such as the option to limit the FPS, disabling and enabling Vsync, or multiple audio sliders to separate sound effects and music. Some gameplay aspects will also be improved, such as an easier way of telling when food is considered properly cooked.
[h2][*]More cosmetic options[/h2]
Over time more cosmetic options will be added.
[/list]

These are the plans for the near future, not necessarily the only updates that the game will receive.

notes.title: Ultrawide screen support
notes.notes: Some users with ultrawide screens were having trouble with some of the UI elements. Adjusted so that is usable.
